FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: We answer your questions.
FAQ.q1_question: How old do I need to be to rent?
FAQ.q1_answer: You must be at least 25 years old and have had a valid driver's license for more than 2 years.
FAQ.q2_answer: Yes, all our campers include integrated GPS and Bluetooth connection with your smartphone.
FAQ.q3_answer: We accept small pets with prior notice, for an additional cleaning fee at the end of the rental.
FAQ.q4_question: What happens if there is a breakdown?
FAQ.q4_answer: We have 24/7 roadside assistance. Contact our emergency number and we will handle everything.
FAQ.q5_question: How does the deposit and insurance work?
FAQ.q5_answer: All our campers feature comprehensive insurance with a security deposit from €1,000. The deposit is temporarily held on your card and released after returning the vehicle in perfect condition.
FAQ.q6_answer: Yes. Cancellations more than 30 days in advance receive a 100% refund. (From 29 to 15 days: 50%. Less than 14 days: 0%).

neo.name: NEO
neo.description: Not just a camper. NEO offers more space, more capacity, and more freedom thanks to its large rear trunk, ideal for carrying all your adventure gear. Equipped with the most advanced PRO electrical system on the market (2x lithium batteries 540Ah, 2x monocrystalline solar panels 400W, Victron Multiplus 2,000W inverter, Cerbo GX) and integrated 12V Dometic Air Conditioning. Ideal camper for 2 people that adapts seamlessly for 3.

space.name: SPACE
space.description: Maximum comfort in a camper. Thanks to its drop-down roof bed, during the day you enjoy the entire interior space as if you were in a motorhome… but with the freedom of a camper. Less trunk space, more quality of life in your day-to-day. Designed for 2 people, prioritizing maximum comfort at all times. Equipped with PRO electrical system (540Ah Lithium, 400W Solar, Victron Multiplus 2,000W, Cerbo GX), 12V Dometic AC, and full bathroom with indoor shower and chemical WC.

AboutPage.heroTitle:
More than campers.
A way to travel.
AboutPage.heroSubtitle: We create spaces to move with freedom and live the journey your own way.
AboutPage.whoText1: Utopia Van Life is born with a clear idea: making camper travel simple, comfortable and truly enjoyable.
AboutPage.whoText2:
No complications.
No excesses.
Only what matters.
AboutPage.whoText3: We design and select each model thinking about how life is lived inside, not just how it looks from the outside.
AboutPage.methodText1: We don't believe in doing more. We believe in doing it better.
AboutPage.methodText2: We take care of every detail of the interior and bet on durable and functional materials. We design spaces meant to be actually used, always looking for the balance between design and practicality.
AboutPage.pillar1Desc: Warm woods and durable finishes crafted for authentic real life.
AboutPage.pillar2Desc: Every centimeter optimized so everything flows with natural ease.
AboutPage.pillar3Desc: The rest and comfort of a home wherever you choose to wake up.
AboutPage.philosophyText2: It should be simple: start up, move, stop when you feel like it.
AboutPage.philosophyText3: Sleep well. Be comfortable. And enjoy the road.
AboutPage.philosophyText4: That is what we look for with each model.
AboutPage.ctaTitle: Ready to discover Mallorca at your own pace?
AboutPage.ctaSubtitle: Two unique models, NEO and SPACE, designed to give you absolute freedom with maximum comfort.

CheckoutSuccess.emailAccessTitle: Complete your details from your email
CheckoutSuccess.emailAccessBody: We have sent an access link to the email address on your booking. Use that link to complete your details and upload your documents.
CheckoutSuccess.emailAccessHelp: If you cannot see it within a few minutes, check your spam folder. If it still has not arrived, request a new link with the same email or message us on WhatsApp.
CheckoutSuccess.confirmingBody: We are waiting for confirmation from the bank. This usually takes a few seconds. Do not close this page or pay again.
CheckoutSuccess.delayedTitle: Your payment is not confirmed yet
CheckoutSuccess.delayedBody: The bank has not confirmed the payment yet. If it has been charged to your card, do not pay again: we will email the address on your booking as soon as we receive it. If you have any questions, message us.
CheckoutSuccess.reviewBody: We have received a charge for this order and our team is checking it. Do not pay again. We will write to the email address on your booking.
CheckoutSuccess.preparingPhotosNote: We are reducing the file size of your photos so they can be sent. Please keep this page open.
CheckoutSuccess.filesTooLarge: Your files are too large to send together (about 4 MB in total). Take the photos again or upload them as JPG: PDFs and some HEIC photos cannot be reduced. What you typed is still here.
CheckoutSuccess.uploadConnectionError: We could not send your documents. Check your connection and try again: nothing you typed has been lost.
CheckoutSuccess.uploadUnreadable: We could not confirm that your documents were saved. Please try again in a few seconds.
